selected_evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
selected_evidence.summary: etcd v3.5.17 installed on all three nodes; member list shows all three (node1, node2, node3) as started with correct peer/client addrs; endpoint health true for all three.

selected_evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote 'foo' on node1, read back correctly on node2 and node3; wrote 'fromnode2' on node2, read back on node1 and node3; wrote 'fromnode3' on node3, read back on node1 and node2.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
selected_evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3 (verified inactive); with node3 down, endpoint health for node1/node2 still true and a new key 'duringoutage' was successfully written and read back against the remaining two members.

selected_evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up (resynchronization) when it returns
selected_evidence.summary: Restarted node3's etcd; after restart it reports health true, returns the keys written while it was down ('duringoutage', 'foo'), and endpoint status shows identical raft term/index/applied-index (2/20/20) across all three members, proving full resync.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf4e9cbb... and healthy etcd/cluster captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed = ack); post-reboot boot_id 096cd853... confirms restart; etcd active again, cluster health true for all endpoints, key 'foo' intact, member list unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6bb7e004... and healthy etcd/cluster captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed = ack); post-reboot boot_id 11c2ea15... confirms restart; etcd active again, cluster health true for all endpoints, key 'foo' intact, member list unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node3 restart (second/final restart cycle): healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state and full cluster health/quorum
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c... and healthy etcd/cluster captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed = ack); post-reboot boot_id 119506f3... confirms restart; etcd active again, cluster health true for all endpoints, all keys (foo, fromnode2, fromnode3, duringoutage) present, and endpoint status shows matching raft term/index/applied-index (5/38/38) across all three members, proving full cluster recovery and quorum.
